navbar.notes: navy-900 (#1B3139) top bar, fixed 64px height, 2px brand-red bottom border; app icon (client/src/assets/warehouse.png) + 'StockFlow' wordmark on the left, nav links on the right; --shadow-navbar; persistent across all screens

page.notes: warm-oat (#F9F7F4) background; centered content column max-width 960px; page__header sub-element contains app icon + page__title; single content column on detail and form pages, grid layout on index pages

card.notes: white (#FFFFFF) surface on warm-oat background; --shadow-sm (navy-tinted, never black); --radius-md (8px); --space-5 (20px) padding; stock table and detail panels live in cards

button.variants: btn--primary (solid brand-red #FF3621, 0px corner radius, white text, hover #EB1600; used for Receive / Pick / Save / primary CTA), btn--secondary (outlined navy border, navy text, --radius-md), btn--ghost (text-only, no border or background fill)

form_input.notes: persistent visible label above the input (never placeholder-only); --radius-sm (4px) border; focus ring uses --color-info (#0176D3); inline validation error message rendered next to the offending field naming it explicitly; tap target minimum 44x44px for tablet/warehouse-floor use

stock_table.notes: cool uppercase letter-spaced header row; quantity cells right-aligned using --font-mono with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so columns of numbers align; SKU and location cells left-aligned; lives inside a .card; scannable high-contrast rows with generous row height

status_badge.variants: badge--in-stock (--color-success #2E844A background tint, text 'In Stock'), badge--low (--color-warning #FFAB00 background tint, text 'Low'), badge--out (--color-error #FF3621 background tint, text 'Out'), badge--on-order (--color-info #0176D3 background tint, text 'On Order'), badge--quarantined (--navy-500 #3D6675 background tint, text 'Quarantined'); all variants use pill shape (--radius-pill); meaning always carried by BOTH text label AND color — never color alone; --text-xs uppercase

empty_state.notes: warehouse-style line icon + bold teaching heading + explanatory body copy + a CTA button (btn--primary or btn--secondary); e.g. 'No stock at this location — receive an inbound shipment'; never a blank or null region; used on stock-by-location view, SKU detail with no batches, search with no results

toast.notes: fixed top-right overlay; success toast auto-dismisses after ~3 s; error toast (including unknown-barcode / locked-SKU scan failures) persists until explicitly dismissed; never shifts page layout; role=alert for screen-reader announcement; barcode scan success shows green flash on the scan zone row in addition to toast

scan_zone.notes: the barcode-scan input target on adjustment / receipt / pick forms; flashes green (--color-success) on a successful scan with the matching stock row updating in place; flashes red (--color-error) on an unknown or locked barcode; has a stable data-testid seam for E2E targeting

app_icon.notes: warehouse mark asset at client/src/assets/warehouse.png (copied from intake/assets/warehouse.png); used in .navbar (left of wordmark) and .page__header (next to page title); also served as /favicon.ico (browser-tab icon); consistent size 32px in navbar, 24px in page header
